name: @playliquid/lab-contracts
description: PlayLiquid GameOS Game Engineering Lab contracts (PL-006). The typed contract layer of the Lab: development-organization descriptors (agents, roles, bodies, ZCode model assignments, tools, capabilities, topology, memory, humans, budget, scheduling, review — R16, lock 25/26), the lab-loop stage vocabulary with typed links, immutable project evidence and append-only calibration (R17, E10, lock 27), explicitly-labeled estimates disjoint from observed evidence (E11, lock 28/29), the capability-gap resolution ladder (R18, lock 30/31/32) and the game-ir evaluation-suite seam (ports only — simulation, search and learning arrive in PL-028..030). Pure types and pure functions only: no IO, no simulation engine, no search algorithms, no Arena SDK, no provider types.
